question: For each concert year, how many concerts were held and how many distinct singers performed?
reference_sql: SELECT c.Year, COUNT(DISTINCT c.concert_ID), COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) FROM concert AS c LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID GROUP BY c.Year
candidate_sql:
SELECT
    c.Year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.concert_ID) AS concert_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.Singer_ID) AS distinct_singer_count
FROM concert AS c
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
    ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
LEFT JOIN singer AS s
    ON TRY_CAST(sic.Singer_ID AS BIGINT) = s.Singer_ID
GROUP BY c.Year
ORDER BY c.Year;
